race.comment: MILITARY JANE (6) never got into the race last start at Belmont but was better the start prior at this track over 1400m. Now out to 1500 for the first time, but the rise in trip looks suitable and her best form stacks right up. May need some luck from the barrier but she's good enough. HE'S ARCHIE (4) disappointed last start when back to 1400m but has a few figures prior that suggest he's not out of this. He lands in the right race today as he comes back in grade and an improved run is on the cards. CHEROKEE MISS (9) has been long odds in her past couple in tougher company and now lands in something more suitable. Fiore taking over is a positive sign and a better showing is expected. KELORA (1) finds the right race today coming back from Saturday company and he's sure to make his presence felt. COSMIC ECLIPSE (3) won't be far away.
